sentences.text_target: The evening arrives and the family meets in the kitchen.
sentences.phonetic: /ði ˈiːvnɪŋ əˈraɪvz ænd ðə ˈfæmɪli miːts ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn/
sentences.text_native: La soirée arrive et la famille se retrouve dans la cuisine.

sentences.text_target: The mother and the father prepare a big dinner.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈmʌðər ænd ðə ˈfɑːðər prɪˈpeər ə bɪg ˈdɪnər/
sentences.text_native: La mère et le père préparent un grand dîner.

sentences.text_target: The sister helps her mother wash the fresh salad.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɪstər hɛlps hɜːr ˈmʌðər wɒʃ ðə frɛʃ ˈsæləd/
sentences.text_native: La sœur aide sa mère à laver la salade fraîche.

sentences.text_target: The brother cuts the potatoes with a sharp knife.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈbrʌðər kʌts ðə pəˈteɪtəʊz wɪð ə ʃɑːrp naɪf/
sentences.text_native: Le frère coupe les pommes de terre avec un couteau bien aiguisé.

sentences.text_target: They cook some delicious chicken in the oven.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ kʊk sʌm dɪˈlɪʃəs ˈtʃɪkɪn ɪn ði ˈʌvən/
sentences.text_native: Ils font cuire un délicieux poulet dans le four.

sentences.text_target: The grandmother sets the table for all the people.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈgrændˌmʌðər sɛts ðə ˈteɪbəl fɔːr ɔːl ðə ˈpiːpəl/
sentences.text_native: La grand-mère met la table pour tout le monde.

sentences.text_target: She puts a white plate in front of every chair.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː pʊts ə waɪt pleɪt ɪn frʌnt ɒv ˈɛvri tʃeər/
sentences.text_native: Elle place une assiette blanche devant chaque chaise.

sentences.text_target: Next to each plate, she places a fork and a spoon.
sentences.phonetic: /nɛkst tuː iːtʃ pleɪt, ʃiː ˈpleɪsɪz ə fɔːrk ænd ə spuːn/
sentences.text_native: À côté de chaque assiette, elle place une fourchette et une cuillère.

sentences.text_target: The young children bring the glasses for the drinks.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə jʌŋ ˈtʃɪldrən brɪŋ ðə ˈglɑːsɪz fɔːr ðə drɪŋks/
sentences.text_native: Les jeunes enfants apportent les verres pour les boissons.

sentences.text_target: Everyone is very hungry after a long day at work.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌwʌn ɪz ˈvɛri ˈhʌŋgri ˈɑːftər ə lɒŋ deɪ æt wɜːrk/
sentences.text_native: Tout le monde a très faim après une longue journée de travail.

sentences.text_target: The grandfather is very thirsty and drinks some cold water.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈgrændˌfɑːðər ɪz ˈvɛri ˈθɜːsti ænd drɪŋks sʌm kəʊld ˈwɔːtər/
sentences.text_native: Le grand-père a très soif et boit de l'eau fraîche.

sentences.text_target: The baby smiles at his aunt and his uncle.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈbeɪbi smaɪlz æt hɪz ɑːnt ænd hɪz ˈʌŋkl/
sentences.text_native: Le bébé sourit à sa tante et à son oncle.

sentences.text_target: The cousin tells a funny story about his new job.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌzən tɛlz ə ˈfʌni ˈstɔːri əˈbaʊt hɪz njuː dʒɒb/
sentences.text_native: Le cousin raconte une histoire drôle sur son nouveau travail.

sentences.text_target: All the family members laugh together at the table.
sentences.phonetic: /ɔːl ðə ˈfæmɪli ˈmɛmbərz lɑːf təˈgɛðər æt ðə ˈteɪbəl/
sentences.text_native: Tous les membres de la famille rient ensemble à table.

sentences.text_target: The food smells really good and makes them happy.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə fuːd smɛlz ˈriːəli gʊd ænd meɪks ðɛm ˈhæpi/
sentences.text_native: La nourriture sent vraiment bon et les met en joie.

sentences.text_target: The mother serves the hot chicken on each plate.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈmʌðər sɜːvz ðə hɒt ˈtʃɪkɪn ɒn iːtʃ pleɪt/
sentences.text_native: La mère sert le poulet chaud dans chaque assiette.

sentences.text_target: The father pours red juice into the glasses.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɑːðər pɔːrz rɛd dʒuːs ˈɪntuː ðə ˈglɑːsɪz/
sentences.text_native: Le père verse du jus de fruits rouge dans les verres.

sentences.text_target: They eat the nice meal and talk about their week.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ iːt ðə naɪs miːl ænd tɔːk əˈbaʊt ðɛər wiːk/
sentences.text_native: Ils mangent ce bon repas tout en parlant de leur semaine.

sentences.text_target: The grandfather listens to his grandchildren with kindness.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈgrændˌfɑːðər ˈlɪsənz tuː hɪz ˈgrændˌtʃɪldrən wɪð ˈkaɪndnɪs/
sentences.text_native: Le grand-père écoute ses petits-enfants avec bienveillance.

sentences.text_target: The aunt explains her interesting daily life.
sentences.phonetic: /ði ɑːnt ɪkˈspleɪnz hɜːr ˈɪntrəstɪŋ ˈdeɪli laɪf/
sentences.text_native: La tante raconte sa vie quotidienne intéressante.

sentences.text_target: The small boy eats all his potatoes very fast.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə smɔːl bɔɪ iːts ɔːl hɪz pəˈteɪtəʊz ˈvɛri fɑːst/
sentences.text_native: Le petit garçon mange toutes ses pommes de terre très vite.

sentences.text_target: The young girl drinks her sweet juice slowly.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə jʌŋ gɜːl drɪŋks hɜːr swiːt dʒuːs ˈsləʊli/
sentences.text_native: La jeune fille boit son jus sucré lentement.

sentences.text_target: The parents look at their children with deep love.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈpeərənts lʊk æt ðɛər ˈtʃɪldrən wɪð diːp lʌv/
sentences.text_native: Les parents regardent leurs enfants avec un amour profond.

sentences.text_target: Everyone enjoys the quiet evening in the warm house.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌwʌn ɪnˈdʒɔɪz ðə ˈkwaɪət ˈiːvnɪŋ ɪn ðə wɔːrm haʊs/
sentences.text_native: Tout le monde profite de cette soirée calme dans la maison chaleureuse.

sentences.text_target: After the meal, the family helps clean the dirty plates.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːftər ðə miːl, ðə ˈfæmɪli hɛlp kliːn ðə ˈdɜːti pleɪts/
sentences.text_native: Après le repas, la famille aide à nettoyer les assiettes sales.

sentences.text_target: The brother washes the forks and the spoons.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈbrʌðər ˈwɒʃɪz ðə fɔːrks ænd ðə spuːnz/
sentences.text_native: Le frère lave les fourchettes et les cuillères.

sentences.text_target: The sister dries the glasses with a clean towel.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɪstər draɪz ðə ˈglɑːsɪz wɪð ə kliːn ˈtaʊəl/
sentences.text_native: La sœur essuie les verres avec un torchon propre.

sentences.text_target: The grandmother puts the food back in the cold fridge.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈgrændˌmʌðər pʊts ðə fuːd bæk ɪn ðə kəʊld frɪdʒ/
sentences.text_native: La grand-mère remet les restes de nourriture dans le réfrigérateur.

sentences.text_target: The relatives say goodbye and walk back to their homes.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈrɛlətɪvz seɪ gʊdˈbaɪ ænd wɔːk bæk tuː ðɛər həʊmz/
sentences.text_native: Les proches se disent au revoir et rentrent chez eux.

sentences.text_target: It was a wonderful weekend night for this big family.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz ə ˈwʌndərfʊl ˈwiːkˌɛnd naɪt fɔːr ðɪs bɪg ˈfæmɪli/
sentences.text_native: C'était une magnifique soirée de week-end pour cette grande famille.
